name: Solenne Mireweft Spire Evening Glove
description:
Opera-length gloves in bioluminescent silk-analog, woven with micro-filament threads that pulse faint gold or rose depending on the wearer's BCI mood-state broadcast. The exterior is matte at rest and shimmers to a liquid sheen under gallery lighting. Seams are hand-finished and invisible. Available in obsidian, bone, and deep lacquer crimson.

Designed for full organic hands but offered in a chrome-cover variant: an inner sleeve of soft chromatic poly-foam shapes to prosthetic hand geometry, masking augmentation entirely behind a flawless glove surface. Wrist closure is a single hidden magnetic clasp.
functionality: BCI mood-state reactive luminescence shifts color passively. Chrome-cover variant conceals prosthetic hands cosmetically. Magnetic wrist clasp allows single-hand fastening. Electrostatic surface treatment resists smudging from handshakes.
what_it_says: Wealth here is architectural — every detail chosen to make power look effortless.
worn_by: high-society augmented individuals wishing to conceal chrome
story_hooks: A stolen pair of chrome-cover gloves contains a micro-transmitter in the poly-foam sleeve — someone has been recording Spire conversations for months.
The mood-reactive filaments can be hacked via BCI spoof to display false emotional states, useful for negotiators or spies.
A grieving heir wears her late mother's pair to the board vote — the gloves still pulse the mother's saved mood profile.
related_entities: Ringo Corponation SlipThread MX-3 Urban Cable Micro-Mobility Rig

physical_description.visual_profile: Elegant opera-length gloves extending past the elbow, creating a refined silhouette that reads haute couture. The matte surface catches light subtly until activated, then transitions to a liquid shimmer. On wearers with BCI integration, faint auroral pulses of gold or rose travel across the fabric in response to emotional states.
physical_description.fit: Precision tailored to the hand and forearm with a second-skin compression fit. The chrome-cover variant accommodates prosthetic geometry seamlessly beneath, creating the visual illusion of flawless organic hands.
physical_description.primary_material: Bioluminescent silk-analog base woven with micro-filament conductive threads. Chrome-cover variant uses soft chromatic poly-foam inner sleeve bonded to the exterior.
physical_description.texture: Exterior is matte silk-like to the touch at rest; seams are hand-finished and completely invisible. Under movement or gallery lighting, the surface develops a liquid, oil-slick sheen. Micro-threads create an imperceptible texture variation.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in obsidian (deep black with rose-gold pulse), bone (cream with warm gold glow), and deep lacquer crimson (dark wine with rose undertones). Bioluminescent elements create dynamic accent colors based on wearer mood-state.
physical_description.closures: Single hidden magnetic clasp at wrist, minimalist and invisible when fastened. No visible hardware.
distinctive_features: BCI mood-state reactive bioluminescence with gold and rose color options
Matte-to-liquid shimmer transition under specific lighting conditions
Chrome-cover inner sleeve option for seamless augmentation concealment
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. Solenne Couture is a premium corpo fashion house; pricing reflects exclusive bioluminescent technology and hand-finishing.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corpo elites, gallery patrons, diplomatic figures, and augmented individuals seeking to project wealth while masking prosthetic modifications. The mood-state reactivity signals BCI integration without being ostentatious.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine and flawless. The hand-finished seams and invisible closures ensure these gloves appear museum-quality even after wear. No patina or distressing is acceptable at this tier.
